entry.en: An ETA is not a visa and does not guarantee entry; it is simply permission to travel.
entry.es: Una ETA no es un visado ni garantiza la entrada; es solo un permiso para viajar.
entry.quote: An ETA is not a visa and does not guarantee entry, it is simply permission to travel.

entry.en: As of 2026 the ETA costs £20 and can be applied for on the web or via Apple or Android apps.
entry.es: A partir de 2026 la ETA cuesta 20 £ y se puede solicitar en la web o mediante aplicaciones de Apple o Android.
entry.quote: As of 2026, the cost of the ETA is £20 and it can be applied for either on the web, or via apps for Apple or for Android.

entry.en: A decision on an ETA application can take up to 72 hours, longer if further checks are needed.
entry.es: La decisión sobre una solicitud de ETA puede tardar hasta 72 horas, más si se necesitan comprobaciones adicionales.
entry.quote: A decision on a traveller's application can take up to 72 hours, longer if further checks are needed.

entry.en: An ETA is valid for up to 2 years or until the passport expires, whichever is sooner.
entry.es: Una ETA es válida hasta 2 años o hasta que caduque el pasaporte, lo que ocurra antes.
entry.quote: Once issued, an ETA will be valid for up to 2 years or until the expiry date of the traveller's passport, whichever is sooner

entry.en: A declaration must be made if carrying more than £10,000 in cash or other negotiable instruments.
entry.es: Hay que hacer una declaración si se lleva más de 10.000 £ en efectivo u otros instrumentos negociables.
entry.quote: You must make a declaration if you are carrying more than £10,000 in cash or other negotiable instruments

entry.en: The UK is harsh on overstaying, which is treated as a breach of immigration law.
entry.es: Reino Unido es estricto con quienes se quedan más tiempo del permitido, lo cual se trata como infracción de la ley de inmigración.
entry.quote: The UK is harsh on overstaying: missing the deadline is treated as a breach of immigration law.

safety.en: The UK is described as generally a safe place to visit.
safety.es: Se describe el Reino Unido como un lugar generalmente seguro para visitar.
safety.quote: In general the UK is a safe place to visit

safety.en: In any emergency, call 999 or 112, the unified emergency number for the UK.
safety.es: En cualquier emergencia, llame al 999 o al 112, el número de emergencias unificado del Reino Unido.
safety.quote: In any emergency call 999 or 112, the unified emergency phone number for the United Kingdom.

safety.en: For non-emergencies you can call 101 to report crime and concerns to the local police.
safety.es: Si no es una emergencia, puede llamar al 101 para denunciar delitos e inquietudes a la policía local.
safety.quote: In a non-emergency situation you can call 101 to report crime and concerns to the local police

safety.en: Late at night it is not uncommon to find rowdy groups of drunk people, especially young men, on the street.
safety.es: Por la noche no es raro encontrar en la calle grupos ruidosos de personas ebrias, sobre todo hombres jóvenes.
safety.quote: Late at night it is not uncommon to find rowdy groups of drunk people, especially young men, on the street

safety.en: Drinking alcohol in public, except outside a bar or pub, is not permitted in some towns and areas of cities.
safety.es: Beber alcohol en público, salvo fuera de un bar o pub, no está permitido en algunas ciudades y zonas urbanas.
safety.quote: Drinking alcohol in public (except outside a bar or pub) is not permitted in some towns and areas of cities.

safety.en: Overt racism is not common in the UK and racially motivated violence is rare.
safety.es: El racismo abierto no es común en el Reino Unido y la violencia por motivos raciales es rara.
safety.quote: Overt racism is not common in the UK and racially motivated violence is rare.

health.en: In a life-threatening medical emergency, telephone 999.
health.es: En una emergencia médica con riesgo vital, llame al 999.
health.quote: If you have a life-threatening medical emergency, telephone ☏ 999.

health.en: For urgent non-life-threatening problems you can call the 24-hour NHS advice line on 111.
health.es: Para problemas urgentes sin riesgo vital puede llamar a la línea de consejo del NHS, 24 horas, al 111.
health.quote: you can call the 24-hour NHS advice line on ☏ 111, stating the nature of the medical concern.

health.en: Non-UK residents will generally be refused treatment at NHS GP practices, but private doctor consultations are available.
health.es: A los no residentes en el Reino Unido generalmente se les deniega la atención en los médicos de cabecera del NHS, pero hay consultas médicas privadas.
health.quote: Non-UK residents will generally be refused treatment at NHS GP practices, but private doctor consultation services are available

health.en: Travel insurance with dental cover is strongly advised.
health.es: Se recomienda encarecidamente un seguro de viaje con cobertura dental.
health.quote: travel insurance with dental cover is strongly advised.

help.es: El número de emergencias es el 999 o el 112.
help.quote: In any emergency call 999 or 112, the unified emergency phone number for the United Kingdom.

getting_in.en: The most important airports are London Heathrow, London Gatwick and Manchester.
getting_in.es: Los aeropuertos más importantes son Londres Heathrow, Londres Gatwick y Mánchester.
getting_in.quote: The most important airports are London Heathrow (LHR IATA), London Gatwick (LGW IATA) and Manchester (MAN IATA).

getting_in.en: England is connected to France by the Channel Tunnel.
getting_in.es: Inglaterra está conectada con Francia por el túnel del Canal de la Mancha.
getting_in.quote: England is connected to France by the Channel Tunnel.

getting_in.en: Northern Ireland shares a land border with the Republic of Ireland.
getting_in.es: Irlanda del Norte comparte frontera terrestre con la República de Irlanda.
getting_in.quote: Northern Ireland shares a land border with the Republic of Ireland.

getting_in.en: Heathrow is the UK's main hub, with direct flights from every continent except Antarctica.
getting_in.es: Heathrow es el principal centro de conexiones del Reino Unido, con vuelos directos desde todos los continentes salvo la Antártida.
getting_in.quote: Heathrow is the United Kingdom's main hub, receiving direct flights from every continent and major landmass but Antarctica

getting_in.en: Most UK airports are served by rail services, which at least offer transport into the nearest city.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de los aeropuertos británicos tienen servicio ferroviario, que al menos lleva a la ciudad más cercana.
getting_in.quote: Most UK airports are served by rail services, which if nothing else offer transport into the nearest city.

getting_around.en: Unlike most of Europe, the UK drives on the left.
getting_around.es: A diferencia de la mayor parte de Europa, en el Reino Unido se conduce por la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: Unlike most of Europe, the UK drives on the left.

getting_around.en: You must have a ticket before boarding a train, and many stations have ticket barriers.
getting_around.es: Hay que tener billete antes de subir al tren, y muchas estaciones tienen barreras.
getting_around.quote: You must have a ticket before boarding a train, and many stations now have ticket barriers.

getting_around.en: On most rail routes you save money by booking in advance and travelling at off-peak times.
getting_around.es: En la mayoría de rutas ferroviarias se ahorra reservando con antelación y viajando en horas valle.
getting_around.quote: On most routes, you save money by booking in advance and by travelling at off-peak times

getting_around.en: Ordinary taxis are metered black cabs that can be hailed in the street, and minicabs that must be ordered by telephone.
getting_around.es: Los taxis ordinarios son los black cabs con taxímetro que se paran en la calle y los minicabs, que hay que pedir por teléfono.
getting_around.quote: There are two types of ordinary taxis in the United Kingdom: metered black cabs that can be hailed in the street and are mostly found in larger towns and cities; and minicabs, or private hire taxis, which must be ordered by telephone.

getting_around.en: Most bus stops are request stops, where you must put your arm out as the bus approaches.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de las paradas de autobús son a demanda: hay que extender el brazo cuando se acerca el autobús.
getting_around.quote: The vast majority of bus stops are "request stops": you must put your arm out as the bus approaches to signal that you want it to stop.

getting_around.en: There is a congestion charge of £11.50 per day to drive in central London.
getting_around.es: Hay una tasa de congestión de 11,50 £ al día por conducir en el centro de Londres.
getting_around.quote: There is a congestion charge of £11.50 per day to drive in central London

money.en: The currency throughout the UK is the pound (GBP).
money.es: La moneda en todo el Reino Unido es la libra (GBP).
money.quote: The currency throughout the UK is the pound (£) (ISO code: GBP).

money.en: Some merchants no longer accept cash.
money.es: Algunos comercios ya no aceptan efectivo.
money.quote: Some merchants no longer accept cash.

money.en: Visa, MasterCard, Maestro and American Express are accepted by most shops and restaurants.
money.es: Visa, MasterCard, Maestro y American Express se aceptan en la mayoría de tiendas y restaurantes.
money.quote: Visa, MasterCard, Maestro and American Express are accepted by most shops and restaurants

money.en: The UK does not have a strong culture of tipping.
money.es: El Reino Unido no tiene una fuerte cultura de las propinas.
money.quote: The UK does not have a strong culture of tipping.

money.en: A tip of about 10-15% is customary in restaurants for good service but is not expected or mandatory.
money.es: Una propina de alrededor del 10-15% es habitual en restaurantes por buen servicio, pero no se espera ni es obligatoria.
money.quote: A tip of about 10-15% is customary in restaurants for good service, but is in no way expected or mandatory.

money.en: The VAT refund scheme for tourists was abolished in 2020, except for those visiting Northern Ireland.
money.es: El sistema de devolución del IVA para turistas se abolió en 2020, salvo para quienes visitan Irlanda del Norte.
money.quote: The previous VAT refund scheme for tourists was abolished in 2020, except for those visiting Northern Ireland.

etiquette.en: A greeting may be accompanied by a handshake between both genders or, for close friends, a hug.
etiquette.es: El saludo puede ir acompañado de un apretón de manos entre ambos géneros o, entre amigos cercanos, de un abrazo.
etiquette.quote: A greeting may be accompanied by a handshake (between both genders) or, for close friends, a hug.

etiquette.en: British people apologise a lot, even when there is no need to.
etiquette.es: Los británicos se disculpan mucho, incluso cuando no hay necesidad.
etiquette.quote: British people apologise a lot, even when there is absolutely no need to do so.

etiquette.en: Trains have clearly marked quiet coaches.
etiquette.es: Los trenes tienen vagones silenciosos claramente señalizados.
etiquette.quote: Trains have designated quiet coaches which are clearly marked.

etiquette.en: A V sign with the palm facing inward is considered an offensive gesture.
etiquette.es: Un signo de V con la palma hacia dentro se considera un gesto ofensivo.
etiquette.quote: doing the reverse where the palm faces inward is considered to be an offensive gesture, equivalent to raising the middle finger.

etiquette.en: Scottish and Welsh independence, Irish reunification and the Troubles are sensitive issues among many people in the UK.
etiquette.es: La independencia de Escocia y Gales, la reunificación irlandesa y los Troubles son temas delicados para muchos en el Reino Unido.
etiquette.quote: Scottish independence, Welsh independence and Irish reunification, and the history of the Troubles, are sensitive issues among many around the UK.

connectivity.en: With an unlocked phone you can buy a SIM card from electrical or phone outlets, supermarkets, newsagents, poundshops or online.
connectivity.es: Con un teléfono desbloqueado se puede comprar una SIM en tiendas de electrónica o telefonía, supermercados, quioscos, tiendas de todo a una libra o en línea.
connectivity.quote: If you have an unlocked phone you can purchase a SIM card from several electrical or phone outlets, supermarkets, newsagents, poundshops or online.

connectivity.en: All mobile providers in the UK have switched off 3G.
connectivity.es: Todos los operadores móviles del Reino Unido han apagado el 3G.
connectivity.quote: 3G has been switched off by all the mobile providers in the UK

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi access across the UK should cost at most £1 for half an hour.
connectivity.es: El acceso wifi en el Reino Unido debería costar como máximo 1 £ por media hora.
connectivity.quote: The most you should pay for Wi-Fi access across the UK is £1 for half an hour.
